lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Wesner, it's Tanya from the coaching program. Is now still a good time?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you hit your goal this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, only 1 days. After treatment I had no energy at all.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I just didn't feel like it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Having a glass of water between drinks is an easy way to slow down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Having a glass of water between drinks is an easy way to slow down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, it was a long weekend with family, you know how it is.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You really shouldn't be drinking at all after cancer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That took effort.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're not really trying.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, but you don't know my schedule.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the band exercises going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've always eaten late, that's how we do it at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. It was a long weekend with family, you know how it is.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the band exercises going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Walking hurts my knees, so why bother.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll try to keep it to 3 drinks on the weekend.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll ask my son to come with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: being so tired made this week harder, you still got 1 days in, and your plan is to keep it to 3 drinks on the weekend. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Wesner. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

flags.reason: Warning about health consequences without permission; MI non-adherent.
Directive 'You have to make this a priority' pushes without partnership.
Absolute directive about drinking; ignores participant autonomy.
Repeats the line 9 directive; repeated persuading.
'I really want to feel like myself again' was met with a persuasive directive instead of reflection.
Confidence statement 'I can do it' not reflected or elaborated.
Verbatim repeat of line 12 ignores participant's response.
Repeats line 27 question verbatim after participant already answered.

score.summary: The coach repeatedly used directives and warnings ('You have to make this a priority', 'You're not really trying') that pushed against the participant's ambivalence and missed clear change talk. The session did reach a concrete goal (3 drinks on weekends), a barrier plan (son joining), and a clear next contact, which are real strengths.
strengths: Set an agenda and invited the participant to adjust it (line 3).
Reviewed the last goal and summarized accurately at line 40.
Helped build a concrete goal and barrier plan (lines 36-39).
coaching_tips: Replace 'You have to make this a priority' (line 9) with a reflection, e.g., 'Part of you wants to feel like yourself again, and part of you is worn out.'
Reflect the change talk at line 8 and line 13 before moving on; these were the strongest motivation cues.
Avoid repeating the same line (lines 12/14, 27/34); respond to what the participant just said instead.
Drop the confrontational 'You're not really trying' (line 25); ask an open question about what got in the way instead.
Ask permission before giving suggestions like the water tip (line 12) rather than repeating it.
